title: Mainsah et al. 2025 — bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset (Study R)
description: This dataset is Study R of the bigP3BCI collection, a large open P300-based brain-computer interface (BCI) resource. It contains 32-channel EEG recorded at 256 Hz from 20 participants over two sessions each, while they used a speller with 9x8 multi-face stimulus paradigms. Target and non-target events are annotated with HED tags. The data are formatted for machine learning and benchmarking with MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) from 32 channels placed according to the standard 10-20 montage, sampled at 256 Hz. Participants performed a visual P300 speller task with a 9x8 character grid and multi-face stimuli, with a calibration phase followed by online testing with feedback. Epochs span 0 to 1.0 s after the stimulus and are labeled Target or NonTarget.
